vetSays.line: A person, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A person, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.
A person, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.

🌱 A person, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks over the garden: turned soil, nothing planted. A person, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm sowed a low wiry shrub with dusty-blue berries that stain everything purple in the empty plot — seed gathered during garden duty.
📋 A person, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
💧 A person, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with 7L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.

SYSTEM: "That was... a lot. The producers say the ratings were historic. I don’t know what to do with that sentence."

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Cameron just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Emma just put down The Eulogy... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village.
